title: 万达华庭
Wanda Residence
location: 成都市天府新区万达华庭
Wanda Huating, Tianfu New Area, Chengdu
intro: 让材质有层次，让生活有余地。一个容纳三代日常与朋友聚会的家。
A layered material palette and room to live. A home for three generations, everyday rituals, and evenings with friends.
story: 委托人从事房地产相关行业多年，接触过许多售楼部与样板间，希望自己的家保有品质感，同时采用简单的设计语言和干练的线条。空间需要兼顾多人社交聚会、调酒小酌、三代人居住，以及智能便捷的日常生活。

With years of experience in real estate, the client wanted the quality of a carefully considered interior without unnecessary complexity. The brief brought together social gatherings, a home bar, three-generation living, and the convenience of a connected home.
approach: 我们重新梳理了原有户型：打开紧邻客厅的卧室，让阳台与公共空间拥有更开阔的视野；同时在入户区域增加一间卧室，回应三代人的居住需求。黑、棕、白相互穿插，木质、石材与漆面在统一的色调中呈现不同的触感。

We reworked the original layout, opening the bedroom beside the living room to extend the view toward the balcony, while adding a bedroom near the entrance for the family's needs. Black, brown, and white form a consistent palette, with wood, stone, and lacquer introducing texture and rhythm.
focus: 从独处到相聚，空间围绕真实的生活场景展开。材质的对比与干净的线条，让品质感融入日常。
From quiet moments to gatherings, the design follows real patterns of living. Contrasting textures and clear lines bring a sense of quality into the everyday.

title: 中洲·锦城湖岸
Jincheng Lakeside
location: 成都市武侯区中洲·锦城湖岸
intro: 在书、木色与光之间，重新找回家的温度。让中世纪设计与当代生活相遇。
Among books, warm wood, and soft light, a home finds its warmth again. Mid-century ideas meet contemporary life.
story: 委托人是一位教授艺术设计的大学老师，刚刚购入这套二手住宅。她并不希望进行大范围拆改，而是希望通过有针对性的局部更新，将居家的温馨与中世纪设计中的优秀理念结合起来。

The client, a university lecturer in art and design, had just purchased this apartment. Rather than an extensive renovation, she wanted a focused update that brought the warmth of home together with the enduring ideas of mid-century design.
approach: 我们将改造重点放在灯光、软装和柜体。原有柜体拆除后，重新思考收纳尺度、使用动线与整体风格；书籍、艺术品、木质家具和不同触感的织物，让空间逐渐成为生活与审美共同生长的地方。

Lighting, furnishings, and cabinetry became the focus. Replacing the original cabinets allowed us to reconsider storage, circulation, and visual language. Books, artwork, wood furniture, and tactile fabrics give everyday life a personal setting.
focus: 保留房子的基础，以恰当的改变回应居住者。比起统一的风格标签，我们更在意一本常读的书、一处舒服的坐席与一盏刚好的灯。
Keeping the bones of the apartment, the design responds to the person who lives here. A favorite book, a comfortable seat, and a well-placed light matter more than a single style label.

title: 金茂·黄金海岸
Golden Coast Home
location: 新疆阿克苏市金茂·黄金海岸
intro: 打开一面墙，也打开生活的视野。为三口之家重新组织一处明亮、简洁的日常。
Opening a wall opens a new perspective. A bright, simple home reorganized for a family of three.
story: 委托人是一位个体商户，为下一代三口之家购入这套二手住宅。她希望在控制预算的前提下，让家拥有更开阔的视野，以及简洁、时尚的空间感，提升一家人的居住体验。
The client purchased this existing apartment for the next generation of her family. With a considered budget, she wanted a more open outlook and a simple, contemporary home for a family of three.
approach: 原始布局难以满足开阔视野的诉求。在取得业主同意后，我们联系开发商获取建筑施工图，重新评估空间布局：打开厨房与客厅之间的墙体，采用开放式厨房，同时完整呈现阳台的弧形，让公共空间重新连接起来。

The original plan limited the sense of openness. With the owner's agreement, we obtained the construction drawings from the developer and reassessed the layout. Opening the division between kitchen and living room and revealing the balcony's curve reconnects the shared spaces.
focus: 将预算用在真正影响生活的改变上。通透的布局、自然的采光与清晰的色彩关系，共同构成这个家的日常底色。
The budget is directed toward changes that make a difference to daily life: an open plan, natural light, and a clear relationship between colors.

title: 荣盛·香榭兰庭
Xiangxie Guesthouse
intro: 六个房间，六种相遇。为城市旅人打造各有表情的小小居所。
Six rooms, six encounters. Individual spaces designed for travelers discovering the city.
story: 项目是一处二楼约240 m²的清水商业空间，委托人希望将其改造为六间民宿。临近成都东站的位置，让空间主要面向来蓉游客；设计需要具有鲜明的辨识度，也要回应实际的运营需求。

An approximately 240 m² unfinished commercial space on the second floor was to become six guest rooms. Near Chengdu East Railway Station, the project serves visitors to the city and needed both a distinct identity and a practical approach to operation.
approach: 我们为六间房分别设定不同的空间语言，让硬装与软装形成各自完整的表达。不同风格为平台展示提供更多可能，也方便委托人根据房源反馈，规划后续空间的设计方向。这里选取两组空间呈现项目的不同面貌。

Each of the six rooms received its own design language, carried through finishes and furnishings. The distinct rooms support varied presentation online and allow the owner to use feedback to guide future properties. This collection presents two of those spaces.
focus: 小空间同样值得被认真设计。以色彩、尺度和细节，为短暂停留创造值得记住的体验。
Small spaces deserve considered design. Color, proportion, and detail turn a short stay into a memorable experience.

title: 空港国际城 LOFT
Airport Loft Collection
location: 成都空港国际城一期、二期、八期
intro: 让小空间拥有更多层次。悬浮楼梯、旧家具与明亮色彩，组成有趣而自在的旅居日常。
More layers in a smaller footprint. Floating stairs, reclaimed furniture, and bright colors shape an easygoing place to stay.
story: 这是松木设计在成都较早承接的一组规模化民宿项目，委托人先后交付12套公寓，其中部分为LOFT结构。他希望在双流机场片区打造具有设计辨识度与居住舒适性的民宿。

One of our earlier multi-property hospitality projects in Chengdu, this collection brought together twelve apartments, including several lofts. The brief called for distinctive, comfortable places to stay in the Shuangliu airport area.
approach: 大部分房源为清水房。我们在LOFT户型中运用悬浮楼梯，并从二手市场挑选家具与装饰品，搭配自流平地面和大白墙。部分旧门板经由DIY转化为开放式厨房台面和推拉门，让预算、材料与空间表达彼此协调。

Most units began as unfinished shells. Floating stairs give the lofts a lighter structure. Secondhand furniture and objects sit alongside seamless floors and white walls, while reclaimed doors become kitchen counters and sliding panels. Budget and material choices become part of the design language.
focus: 好设计也可以来自旧物的新用法。保留材料的个性，在有限的面积里创造更多可体验、可停留的角落。
Good design can begin with a new use for an old object. Keeping the character of materials creates more places to explore and enjoy within a compact footprint.

title: 花果园旅居公寓
Huaguoyuan Stays
intro: 从普通出租屋，变成有性格的旅途落脚点。用克制的投入，重新发现空间的可能。
Everyday rentals become places with personality. A measured investment reveals new possibilities in existing rooms.
story: 花果园是松木设计较早的异地项目。委托人交付14套带基本装修的出租屋，希望改造为面向游客的民宿。在竞争密集的片区，项目既要建立空间特色，也要把改造投入控制在合理范围。

One of our earliest projects outside our home city, Huaguoyuan involved fourteen already-finished rental apartments. The owner wanted to welcome short-stay visitors, balancing a distinct identity with a carefully controlled renovation budget.
approach: 现场房屋维护情况并不理想，许多房间需要先处理墙面基层、重新涂刷，再清理废旧家具，为木工造型与新的布置留出空间。我们围绕现有条件展开局部更新，让家具、灯光、色彩与细节形成各有特色的居住场景。

The existing rooms needed foundational work: repairing wall surfaces, repainting, and clearing worn furniture before new joinery and furnishings could be introduced. Focused changes to furniture, light, color, and detail give each room a specific character.
focus: 从已有的条件出发，让每一处改变都有理由。空间的焕新，始于对日常使用的重新理解。
Every change begins with the conditions already in place. A renewed space starts with a fresh understanding of how it will be used.
